description: Native one-environment benchmark scope for the thesis comparison pipeline.

core_engines.notes: Plain DiCE baseline with native library behavior and no added pipeline constraints.
DiCE with native features_to_vary and permitted_range constraints, without production post-filtering.
DiCE with native constraints, then passed through the production hardening pipeline. Isolates the contribution of the production gates on identical DiCE generation.
Nearest-neighbor production pipeline used by the microservice with mature validation and ranking.
